Game Overview

Aladdin Platformer puts players into a adventure experience centered on embark on an exhilarating adventure with Aladdin. Leap through vibrant worlds, toss apples, and wield your sword to defeat numerous villains. Glide on a magic carpet towards the ultimate showdown against Jafar in this captivating journey of daring feats and stunning visuals.
